items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: Benny used to tell us about how he would come up there and he would sneak around in the crowd

ctx.x: Jay, after that night did the people come up from downtown. Did the word get around.

Oh, yes, the word got around, but it takes Benny Webster to tell it though. Benny Webster because he came up, had been catching the group and he went downtown on 52nd Street and says, now, all you guys that call yourselves saxophone players, he says, you better go uptown to the Savoy Ballroom and go to school. They got some little young cat out of Kansas City up there and nobody know what he's doing. He said, the reason I know is because I've been up there myself, and Benny used to tell us about how he would come…

It was the band. That was the secret, the whole band, but you see, it started -- it all started from a generation from the rhythm section. The generator from the rhythm section as the rhythm section began to generate --
